generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Try again. If the problem persists, reload the app.

import.corrupted: This file appears unreadable or damaged.
import.tooLarge: This file exceeds the {{maxMb}} MB limit.
import.tooLong: This media exceeds the {{maxMinutes}} minute limit.
import.noAudioTrack: This video has no audio track.
import.decodeFailed: This media can't be read on this device.

url.invalid: That address isn't valid. It must start with https://
url.blockedHost: This site doesn't allow direct downloads. Save the video to your camera roll, then import the file.
url.fetchFailed: The file couldn't be downloaded. The site may be refusing it, or the address doesn't point to a file.
url.notMedia: That address doesn't return an image, video or audio file.

storage.quotaExceeded: Not enough storage space. Remove some media.

ai.tooLarge: This audio is too large to send. Shorten the excerpt.
ai.tooLong: This audio is too long to transcribe. Shorten the excerpt.
ai.unauthorized: API key rejected. Check it and try again.
ai.rateLimited: Quota reached. Wait a moment, then try again.
ai.noAudioSupport: This engine can't transcribe audio. Use Gemini.
ai.emptyResult: No lyrics were found in this audio.
ai.requestFailed: The request failed. Check your connection.

speech.unsupported: Dictation isn't available in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge.

lyricsFile.unreadable: This file isn't a recognisable .lrc or .srt.
lyricsFile.empty: No timed lyrics were found in this file.

audio.decodeFailed: This audio file couldn't be decoded.
audio.tooQuiet: This file is too quiet to detect a beat.

unsupportedBrowser.title: Export isn't available in this browser
unsupportedBrowser.body: Beatapp encodes video directly on your device, which needs a recent browser. Open Beatapp in Chrome (Android) or Safari 26 or newer (iPhone).
unsupportedBrowser.fallbackNote: WebM isn't accepted by Instagram, but works on WhatsApp and desktop.

export.empty: Add at least one clip before exporting.
export.outOfMemory: Not enough memory. Try medium quality or a shorter reel.
